headline: Instagram leads the program: video reaches 2.15x its static posts there and it ranks 1 of 5 on watch minutes per video.
On YouTube a long-form video earns 16.0 subscribers at the median against 3.5 for a Short, and 3540.5 watch minutes against 295.0, so 2 long episodes a cycle anchor the program.

TikTok's median video shows 5532 views, more than any other network's median, but TikTok counts every start and replay; on watch minutes per video it ranks 3 of 5, so it gets one test cycle, not the lead.
On LinkedIn static wins (0.66x), so LinkedIn gets no video for now.
16 hours a week buys 2 long episodes and 15 shorts per 4-week cycle (3.75 a week on every network in the plan), with 0.65 hours of buffer.
